author: City of Long Branch
title: Call for muralists — Long Branch Arts & Cultural Center
content: CALL FOR MURALISTS! The Long Branch Arts & Cultural Center is seeking an artist or artist team to design & paint a mural on the back exterior wall of the Arts & Cultural Center. Send your proposal to mfischer@longbranch.org by September 15th!
